messages:
elaine_support: Escalating onboarding/regression for customer AquaSentry. They report embeddings changed suddenly for their search index after yesterday's model sync. Search recall dropped and they flagged 3 high-priority examples that now return irrelevant results. Moving to CS for comms + renewal risk assessment.

notif-bot: New ticket CS-5241 created by elaine_support (severity: P1). Link: https://tickets.internal/CS-5241

mike_csm: Ack @elaine_support. Renewal in ~30 days; this could impact go-live. Need a short customer note and a remediation timeline. Can eng reproduce?

deepa_cs_ops: Action plan suggestion: 1) Immediate customer acknowledgement with brief non-technical explanation 2) Triage with eng to determine root cause (model vs data) 3) Provide ETA for a mitigation and an option to rollback to prior embedding snapshot 4) Log renewal-risk and offer a short credits package if needed. Who owns rollback?

kevin_infra: Quick check: model sync ran 2025-01-11 03:12 UTC. We keep embedding snapshots for 14 days. I can restore last snapshot to a staging index within 2 hours for validation. If they want production rollback we'll need a change window (~30m) and approval.

elaine_support: Customer examples pasted below. They want to know if this is a config change on their side or our model update.
- example 1: query "cardiac alert rules" -> returns unrelated docs
- example 2: query "oncall escalation" -> returns finance KB

kevin_infra: From quick diff, the embedding vectors shifted slightly after the sync; that points to model update rather than customer config. Could be model tokenizer or small weight change.

mike_csm: Draft message to customer (non-technical): "Thanks for raising this, AquaSentry. We saw an unexpected change in our embedding sync that may have affected search relevance. We're investigating now, and will either restore the previous index or deploy a targeted fix. Expect an update within 2 hours and a resolution path within 24 hours. Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing your account." Thoughts?

deeepa_cs_ops: Edit: include explicit rollback option and ask for permission to perform the rollback if we validate it helps. Also offer a short support credit if this delays go-live.

elaine_support: Sent to customer at 2025-01-11T10:15:00Z. They replied: "Please restore previous behavior ASAP. We'll approve rollback if it fixes things."

kevin_infra: Restored staging snapshot and validated with the provided examples — relevance matched prior behavior. Production rollback approved by customer; scheduling prod rollback now. ETA 40 minutes for rollback + validation.

notif-bot: CS-5241 status updated: mitigation scheduled (rollback).

mike_csm: Noting renewal-risk flag on account and scheduling a 30m post-incident review tomorrow. @deepa_cs_ops please draft incident summary once rollback validation complete.

deeepa_cs_ops: Will capture timeline and customer comms. Action items: 
- [ ] kevin_infra: complete production rollback and post-validation (ETA +40m)
- [ ] elaine_support: confirm customer acknowledgement and monitor feedback
- [ ] mike_csm: update renewal playbook and follow up with AE about credits

kevin_infra: Rollback completed at 2025-01-11T10:58:30Z. Validation checks passed for the three flagged examples and a 200-sample recall test. Monitoring for one hour.

elaine_support: Customer confirmed at 2025-01-11T11:05:14Z: "Search looks back to normal. Thanks."

mike_csm: Great work. We'll keep the renewal flagged until postmortem. Deepa, please include suggested remediation (snapshot retention policy, model rollout gating for customer-facing indices) in the summary.

deeepa_cs_ops: Will do. Closing on this thread after postmortem draft.
